A charming melody that brings back the golden magic of 1960s Bollywood! Enjoy “Kahan Chal Diye Idhar To Aao” from the classic film Jhuk Gaya Aasman (1968), featuring the evergreen screen pairing of Rajendra Kumar and Saira Banu.Sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi, this delightful song captures the romance and musical elegance of Hindi cinema's golden era.
